text: Good evening. Police in four cities are investigating a series of disappearances reported over the past eleven days.
In each case, the missing person was last seen inside a public building. A supermarket. A hospital. A subway station. A parking garage.
This footage, from a twenty-four hour store, shows a customer walking into an aisle at three fourteen a.m. Staff say she never came out.
At Saint Anne's Hospital, a lift was recorded opening onto a floor the building does not have.
Transit police have declined to comment on footage from Line Two.
Investigators say there is no evidence the cases are connected.
Police say the buildings are safe, and remain open.
Attention shoppers. The store will close in fifteen minutes. Please bring your items to the front.
Attention shoppers. The store will close in fifteen minutes. Please bring your items to the back.
Attention shoppers. The store does not close.
